# Downloading

Open-source Windows media downloader with video/audio quality selection powered by yt-dlp.

## Windows downloads
- Installer: https://github.com/amirhoseinteras/downloading-desktop/releases/latest/download/Downloading-Setup.exe
- Portable ZIP: https://github.com/amirhoseinteras/downloading-desktop/releases/latest/download/Downloading-Portable.zip
- SHA-256 checksums: https://github.com/amirhoseinteras/downloading-desktop/releases/latest

Unsigned binaries may show a Windows SmartScreen warning. Always verify the release checksums.

## Source, documentation and support
- Instructions, requirements, license and limitations: https://github.com/amirhoseinteras/downloading-desktop#readme
- Report issues: https://github.com/amirhoseinteras/downloading-desktop/issues
- Source code and reproducible build instructions: https://github.com/amirhoseinteras/downloading-desktop
